eps.o: At age 13, Mica meets charismatic pastor John-Paul. Years later, their secret affair leads to marriage — but behind closed doors, he tightens control.
As their marriage deteriorates, JP blurs the line between care and control. Torn between leaving and protecting the church, Mica fights to break free.
With hope on the horizon, Mica's life ends in a sudden, mysterious tragedy. Systemic failures come to light as her family's fight for truth unfolds.
